notes.title: Update, version 2.1.3
notes.content:
Hi guys

Starship Intruder has been updated to version 2.1.3. Most changes are minor, but some noteable ones are:

- More ammo (bolts)
- Range of bolts now covers the entire screen - but will be more inprecise plus increased travel time
- Added another space card. Drawing this card will produce a scatter-bolt shot from your ship. 

Thanks for reading. 

Isocube Software

notes.title: Starship Intruder 2.0
notes.content:
Hi all

Several changes has been made for the game. The largest is the inclusion of "space cards", which are cards you can draw at any time in the game. Cards are found on planets and they require "card points" to draw. "Card points" are obtained by defeating enemy spaceships.

The main screen of the game now has a menu, consisting of subpages covering a command list, instructions and gameplay tips. You can also choose to start the game with - or without - space cards.

Smaller changes include stuff like changes to photon torpedo movement. They will now move in a more "Proper" arc when homing on an enemy. The remaining changes are rather boring, and will not be covered here.

Thanks for your time,

Nicholas
